profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer with over a 11 years of experience in the software industry. I have a strong background in automation and I am hard working/motivated to continue expanding my knowledge in the field of Computer Science.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer working on Ansible Automation Platform.

positions.title: Principal Software Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Contributor to testing Managed OpenShift (OSD, ROSA) offerings within Service Delivery
    * Contributed features/bug fixes to Managed OpenShift end to end test framework
    * Contributed improvements and increased quality for Managed OpenShift operator tests
    * Revised Managed OpenShift CI jobs to test more frequently on nightly builds
    * Automated test suites to cover HyperShift infrastructure cluster upgrades

Architect/Team Lead for Cloud Services & Platform Integration QE team
    * Designed and implemented CI pipelines to test multi product solutions
    * Designed and implemented CI pipelines to test layered products on top of OpenShift and RHEL
    * Automated multi product solutions based on customer use cases.
    * Automated layered product interoperability scenarios on top of OpenShift and RHEL
    * Developed cloud failover/monitor application for multi product solutions to handle provisioning failures
    * Created technical design documents/diagrams to solve complex problems
    * Technical mentor/coach for junior level associates

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Primarily focused on automation for various projects in multi-product QE.

Involved with converting monolithic applications into microservices that were containerized to run in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

Developed a form for submitting new customer scenario requests for evaluation. The HTML form was hosted on an internal page which sent a request via JavaScript to a Python web application to handle creating a Jira task for the request. On completion, the Jira task ID was sent back to the submitter of the form.

Co-developed a framework for executing multi-product interoperability scenarios. Framework consisted of provision systems, configure systems, execute tests and report test results. Lead the team towards the first release for use by all of QE.

Co-developed a tool to provision and configure Windows environments using Ansible/PowerShell scripts. This offered a cost free way to test Linux products and Windows environments using the 30 day trial period and reduced the need to maintain static Windows servers. Provided technical talk at the yearly global QE event on the tool.

Co-developed a microservice application to provide a simplified way to provision system resources in cloud providers (i.e. AWS, GCE, OpenStack). Provided a command line interface for easy sending requests to service over HTTP protocol.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for improving/maintaining the internal performance test tool and creating automation for new testing initiatives.

- Heavily involved with continuing to improve the performance test tool automation and longevity testing.
- Redesigned the performance test tool to support multiple users using the framework. Previously was only designed for one user.
- Open bugs for software defects found, work with developers for reproducing the bug and re-run automation to verify the bug was fixed in a new software release.
- Test customer bugs to reproduce problems internally and test new fixes provided by development to verify the bug was resolved for the customers.
- Developed automation to simulate a customer environment when undergoing a Session Border Controller upgrade to next software release. Automation verifies the upgrade was successful by meeting a standard list of requirements.
- Audit Miercom Certification for the latest Session Border Controller 7000 product launch.

positions.title: Associate Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for improving/maintaining the internal performance testing tool.

- Provided code enhancements to ensure the performance test tool continued to be robust between Session Border Controller software releases.
- Run performance tests for different Session Border Controller products on development and maintenance releases. This required following installation procedures to install new software versions and verify systems were stable before starting tests.
- Open bugs for software defects found, work with developers for reproducing the bug and re-run automation to verify the bug was fixed in a new software release.
- Continued providing lab support for Session Border Controllers.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for working on the internal performance testing tool.

- Created code enhancements to the performance test tool.
- Automated feature test cases for Session Border Controller upcoming software release.
- Provided lab support for Session Border Controllers.
- Troubleshooting Session Border Controllers and networking issues.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Responsible for working with the development team on a new internal employee time tracker application while attending school full time.

positions.description: Banquet and Function Server/Set Up
